text: 1.All applicants should hold Senior School (or above) diploma(non-degreeprogram is not required).2.All applicants should hold a valid passport.3.Applicants for Clinical Medicine and Nursing Undergraduate Program should have 60% score or above of the courses in principle, such as English, chemistry and biology.4.Applicants for Civil Engineering Undergraduate Program should have 60% score or above of the courses in principle, such as English and mathematics.5.Applicants for 5-year Clinical Medicine Undergraduate Program(Chinese medium) should offer HSK4 or above certificate.6.Applicants should be good in character and holds non-criminal record.7.They should abide by the laws and regulations of Chinese government, obey the university regulations and respect Chinese people’s social custom and habits.8.In the process of reviewing applicants’ documents, the university will prefer to admit those who get higher marks in senior high school education.
